convertibility_reason: Includes custom .mqh file (SignalEnvelopes-jpalonso.mqh) which overrides standard CSignalEnvelopes behavior. The custom signal filter logic is not visible in this file, requiring manual inspection of the .mqh to determine entry/exit conditions. Additionally uses MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework which adds abstraction complexity.

other_exits: Signal threshold close (10) via CExpertSignal may close position on opposite signal

custom_logic_notes: Uses custom SignalEnvelopes-jpalonso.mqh which likely modifies the standard CSignalEnvelopes signal generation logic. The standard CSignalEnvelopes buys when price touches/crosses lower band and sells when price touches/crosses upper band, but the custom .mqh may alter thresholds or add filters. OnTick has a PositionSelect(Symbol()) guard that skips all processing if a position already exists — this effectively limits to 1 position at a time and blocks new entries while in a trade. There is also a hardcoded date filter (D'2012.10.08 10:55') that prevents trading before that timestamp — likely a backtest start date. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated per bar, not per tick. Signal_ThresholdOpen=10 and Signal_ThresholdClose=10 are the CExpertSignal voting thresholds — the Envelopes filter has Weight=1.0 so it alone must exceed the threshold of 10. The relationship between Weight and Threshold in MQL5 Standard Library is: signal_strength * Weight compared to Threshold; with Weight=1.0 and Threshold=10, the raw signal strength from the filter must reach 10 (range 0-100).
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol 200+ bar history H1 or higher 730 days
python_conversion_notes: The main challenge is the custom SignalEnvelopes-jpalonso.mqh — its signal generation logic must be read and reimplemented manually. The standard Envelopes signal in MQL5 Standard Library works as: Long when price crosses below lower band (strength proportional to how far below), Short when price crosses above upper band. The custom .mqh may modify this. For Python conversion: compute SMA(200) and Envelopes bands at ±0.35% deviation, then replicate the signal threshold logic. Fixed SL=77 points (7.7 pips for 5-digit broker), TP=127 points (12.7 pips). One position at a time enforced by PositionSelect guard. Fixed lot size of 5.0. Remove the hardcoded date filter for general backtesting. Per-bar evaluation only (EveryTick=false).
